item.title: IsaacLab - DRL Workflow
item.description:
Train DRL policy using IsaacLab has two approaches (workflow). 1st Direct based (fast code edits), 2nd is Manager-based (Reusable).

Both workflows yield same result. But different use-case.

Direct-Based workflow is like a whitebox. Entire Simulation, scene, terrain and training code are all under one roof. Easy to bring, modify and log things making fast development.

In Manager-based, everything is managed by different python and .yaml config files prioritizing code reusability. But, will be challenging chasing the file hierarchy for making any tweaks in the scene.

My take will be Manager-based workflow would be suitable for industry setting and Direct-based for researchers.

Thanks for Reading.
